summary: Meta's photo and video network — strong social graph but Reels competes directly with AI-generated visual content.
moat: Instagram's moat is the social graph of personal relationships built over 15 years and integrated into Meta's identity infrastructure. Its creator economy tools and direct-messaging fabric are sticky across demographics. However, the Reels feed competes head-to-head with AI-generated imagery and video, and its discovery mechanism rewards novelty over authentic connection.

challengers.name: AI image generators (Midjourney, DALL-E, Adobe Firefly)
challengers.evidence: Midjourney processed over 15 billion image generations by 2024, with many creators choosing AI-generated visuals over photo shoots for brand content on Instagram.
